_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ikam Player {player_id} di pamainan LinesOfAction.
Biji-biji ikam adalah '{side}', biji lawan adalah '{other}'.
Format garak: `[b1b3]` (matang ka-coord). Sabuah garak nang sah bakalih horizontal, vertikal, atawa diagonal sagan banyaknya petak nang sama lawan jumlah biji (warna apa haja) di garisnya. Ikam kawa malompati biji ikam surang, tapi kada biji lawan; mendarat di atas biji lawan manangkapnya.  Manang wayah semua biji ikam tasambung lawan 8-tatangga.

invalid_move.wrong_distance: Harus bergerak jarak nang sama lawan potongan dalam garis.
invalid_move.destination_own: Tujuan nang ditempati oleh pasukan sendiri.
